R0.rationale: Exact original reward; use original environment output.

R1.rationale: Reduce transient progress credit, retain a large terminal success gap, jointly price observed force and moment.

R2.rationale: Quadratic normalized task potential gives more credit near full phase-chain completion; increase online acceleration proxy cost.

R3.rationale: Uniform positive scaling of R1 by its absolute failure penalty15 plus floor15; probe critic/GAE/joint-clip coupling with unchanged parent optimizer and critic. No preference or physics change.

R4.rationale: Single preregistered moment-price hypothesis; all costs/floor independently recomputed.

reward_definition.evaluation_contract: Original unmodified R0/scorer; full task first

selected.execution_mode: stochastic actual learned checkpoint Gaussian, raw then original clip
